solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Draughtsman's gender is problematic

definitions.note: read as 'Draughtsman is', the 's standing for the link word is

indicators.note: something problematic is troubled and unsettled, so these letters must be put in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a draughtsman's sex is a tricky question.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is 'gender is', so the 's of Draughtsman's has to be read as 'is' joining definition to wordplay, while the second 'is' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A draughtsman draws up plans, which is the work of a designer: a near synonym.

clue.text: Can't stand extremely dire cricket matches

indicators.note: extremely means only the extreme letters, first and last, of the word dire are taken

parts.note: Test matches are the long international games of cricket

explanation.surface: Someone finds dreadful cricket fixtures unbearable.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test is a multi-day international cricket match.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unable to bear something is to hate or loathe it: a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Marsh plant in small border

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a border is an edge or margin

explanation.surface: A wetland plant is growing in a narrow flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedges are grass-like plants that grow in wet ground: an example of a marsh plant.

clue.text: Political group has signal to go and have fun

parts.note: a green light is the signal to go
to party is to celebrate and have fun

explanation.surface: A political movement has the go-ahead to enjoy itself.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the name of environmentalist political organisations in many countries: an example of a political group.

clue.text: One flipping expression of disgust is sufficient

indicators.note: flipping turns the word One over so it is read from the end back

parts.note: ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: A single exasperated outburst says it all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British swearword qualifying 'expression', but it reverses ONE to ENO.
explanation.definitionFit: Adequate in amount: a straight synonym, as in 'that's plenty'.

clue.text: Cut deeply into good wood

parts.note: ash is a timber tree and its wood

explanation.surface: A carpenter carves deeply into a fine piece of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: To slash or wound with a long deep incision: a synonym verb.

clue.text: Motivated by a stick to secure employment

indicators.note: to secure is to hold fast, so the stick's letters close round the employment's

parts.note: a rod is a stick
employment of something is its use

explanation.surface: Someone is driven to work by the threat of a beating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by a stick' suggests the means of motivation, but 'a' is simply a letter and the stick is a word to be filled.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirred into action or excited: a synonym in the past participle.

clue.text: Ivy's partner, a prickly girl?

definitions.meaning: the carol 'The ... and the Ivy' pairs the two evergreens
a girl's name that is also a spiky-leaved shrub

explanation.surface: A woman called Ivy has a bad-tempered girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: The evergreen shrub with spiny leaves is paired with ivy at Christmas, and is also a female first name.

clue.text: Highly desirable change of editor

indicators.note: a change of these letters means they are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A new editor is a very welcome development.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' looks like a link word but is part of the fodder: OFEDITOR rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for something wonderful, so desirable that one would give one's life for it.

clue.text: Thwart, using this sword?

definitions.meaning: to thwart is to frustrate or prevent someone's plan

explanation.surface: A fencer blocks an opponent's attack with the blade.
explanation.definitionFit: To frustrate a plan is one sense; the other is the button-tipped blade used in fencing.

clue.text: Success with girl is random

parts.note: a hit is a success, as of a song
and means together with
Miss is the title of a girl or unmarried woman

explanation.surface: A man's triumph with a young woman is a matter of chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Haphazard, sometimes working and sometimes not: an adjective idiom close to random.

clue.text: Radiance noticed around husband

indicators.note: around says the letters for noticed go round the letter for husband

parts.note: noticed means seen
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone spotted a glow about her spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft glossy shine or lustre: a synonym of radiance.

clue.text: To contradict wins, always

parts.note: to win is to gain
ay, also spelt aye, is an old word for always or ever

explanation.surface: Arguing back always pays off.
explanation.walkthrough: AY for 'always' is archaic and poetic, as in 'for ay'.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny or speak against: a formal synonym verb.

clue.text: Son quietly studied feast

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to read a subject at university is to study it

explanation.surface: A boy silently looks over the banquet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'read' for studied is British university usage: one reads history at Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: A lavish meal laid out on the table: an informal synonym.

clue.text: Plaything bagged regularly in cylindrical pack

indicators.note: in says the picked letters sit inside the pack's letters

parts.note: a roll is a pack wound into a cylinder, like a bedroll

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of bagged is taken

explanation.surface: A toy is stuffed into a rolled-up bundle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes A, G, D, the even letters of 'bagged'.
explanation.definitionFit: A floppy soft doll is a child's toy: an example of a plaything.

clue.text: Robber gang taking computer technology

parts.note: a band is a gang or group
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: Criminals are stealing computers.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlaw who robs travellers: a synonym for robber.

clue.text: Pupil's support of course keeps artist at home

definitions.note: read as 'Pupil is', the 's standing for the link word is

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so the support's letters hold the others

parts.note: a tee supports the ball on a golf course
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
in means at home

explanation.surface: A student's support of a course of study houses an artist who stays in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' is a golf course, not a course of study.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone being taught a skill or job is a learner, a synonym for pupil.

clue.text: Decorous publicity about string of pearls, perhaps

indicators.note: about means around, so the publicity letters go round the string

parts.note: PR is public relations, publicity
a rope is a long string of pearls

explanation.surface: Seemly advertising concerns a necklace.
explanation.definitionFit: Correct and respectable in behaviour: a synonym for seemly or decorous.

clue.text: Open boat that smoker may use

definitions.meaning: a flat-bottomed barge for unloading ships
a device for setting light to a cigarette

explanation.surface: A smoker reaches for something in an open boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a barge used to ferry cargo, and a pocket device that produces a flame.

clue.text: Maximum speed came down, motorway included

indicators.note: included says the motorway letter is held inside the other word

parts.note: lit is a past tense of alight, came down to land
M1 is Britain's main London-to-Leeds motorway, written MI in letters

explanation.surface: The speed restriction dropped once the motorway was added.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the British motorway north from London; its 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: The most that is allowed: the speed cap on a road is the legal ceiling.

clue.text: To some extent liked a chair for Russian cottage

indicators.note: To some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone was rather fond of a seat in a Russian country house.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'for', which is only a link joining wordplay to definition, so the definition is 'Russian cottage'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dacha is the word for a Russian country house or summer villa.

clue.text: Councillor that is right for reader of proclamations

parts.note: i.e. is id est, that is

explanation.surface: A local councillor turns out to be the right person to read public notices.
explanation.walkthrough: A town crier is the official who once called out public announcements in the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Town criers read official announcements aloud in public: a description of the role.

clue.text: Low river in high ground

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow

explanation.surface: A shallow river runs across the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb for a cow's call.
explanation.definitionFit: An open upland of heath, like Dartmoor: an example of high ground.

clue.text: Work with artist, say, a producer of spectacles

parts.note: op, opus, is a musical work

indicators.note: say signals the next word is to be heard and spelt as it sounds

parts.note: Titian was the Venetian Renaissance painter

explanation.surface: Collaborating with a painter results in a grand show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spectacles' suggests shows, but means glasses. The painter's name is spoken 'tish-un', spelt TICIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An optician makes and sells eyeglasses, so is literally a producer of glasses.

clue.text: Instructed dolt to move

indicators.note: to move the letters of dolt is to shift them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A fool was ordered to get going.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordered or directed someone to do something: a synonym in the past tense.

clue.text: Keep page at front of book

indicators.note: at front of places the page letter before the booking word

parts.note: to book is to reserve

explanation.surface: Keep a page at the start of the volume.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep safe or maintain intact: a synonym verb.
